name: Question 5
problem:
Consider the linear transformation 
$T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}2x-4y+4z \\ -5x+10y-3z \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ 
and the vectors 
${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],{v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 5 \\ 3\end{aligned}],{v}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}].$
Which of the given vectors belong to $\text{Ker}(T)?$
worked_solution:
A vector $u$ belongs to the kernel of a linear transformation $T$ if $T(u)=0.$ 

Therefore, we need to compute $T({v}_{i})$ for each ${v}_{i}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}T({v}_{1}) & =T([\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 12 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ T({v}_{2}) & =T([\begin{aligned}10 \\ 5 \\ 3\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}12 \\ -9 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ T({v}_{3}) & =T([\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Since $\,T({v}_{3})=0,$ we conclude that the only vector that belongs to the kernel of $\,T$ is $\,{v}_{3}.$

choices.value: None of the given vectors belong to the kernel of $T$

html:
Question 5
?

Consider the linear transformation T:[xyz]⟶[2x−4y+4z−5x+10y−3z0] and the vectors v1=[121],v2=[1053],v3=[210]. Which of the given vectors belong to Ker(T)?

a
None of the given vectors belong to the kernel of T
b
v2 and v3 only
c
v2 only
d
v1 and v2 only
e
v3 only
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

A vector u belongs to the kernel of a linear transformation T if T(u)=0.

Therefore, we need to compute T(vi) for each vi:

T(v1)=T([121])=[−2120]T(v2)=T([1053])=[12−90]T(v3)=T([210])=[000]

Since T(v3)=0, we conclude that the only vector that belongs to the kernel of T is v3.
